Project portfolio

Machine learning research

Federated learning for ASD research

An experimental cross-silo training framework for a facial-image classification task across three datasets.

FlowerEfficientNetTensorFlow

Engineering case study

Train across three clients while keeping images local.

Method

Three clients trained an EfficientNet-based model using transfer learning and federated averaging. The experiment ran for 80 rounds.

Reported results

The résumé reports 95.2% global accuracy across an experiment using 12,423 images, with the best checkpoint at round 33 and a 1.8 percentage-point cross-client accuracy gap.

Interpretation

These results describe the study datasets and evaluation protocol. Dataset composition and generalisation to other populations limit the conclusions. The work is presented as a machine-learning experiment.
